title: onboard_session
description: Answer to onboard_start. The device builds its QR code from hub_id, its own pinned fingerprint (not from this message), session_id and its public key (deep-link/onboard-link.json) and shows code under it (“428 913”) for typing on the confirming device. When a confirming device looked it up the hub sends onboard_claimed.

code.description: 6-digit code of this session: show it in two groups of three under the QR code. Valid as long as the session, used up by the first successful lookup with it.
